title: Hansen P4 Gearbox
description: Sumitomo Hansen P4 single stage gearbox for cooling tower fan drives, built for compact reduction needs. Get pricing from ICST.

paragraphs: The Hansen P4 product range of single stage gear units comes in a parallel horizontal configuration. The monobloc single stage units are available in five sizes (C through G) with torque ratings from 15-75kNm and ratios between 1.2 and 5.6. The performance of single-stage P4 units is characterized by low noise, light weight, and reliability.
Standardized heavy duty single stage gear units:

With this range of heavy duty single stage gear units, HIT extends its current single stage offering further into the multi-megawatt power range. These single stage units make use of the proven Hansen P4 technology and are especially suitable to drive large pumps, blowers, compressors, refiners, etc.
The Heavy duty single stage unit is available in a parallel horizontal configuration with split housing.
